ad-page/ai-agents: Introduces the AI agents on an ad landing page, one card per agent with its name and the single job it does
ad-page/comparison-table: Sets Gushwork against other options in a side-by-side table on an ad landing page, one row per point of comparison
ad-page/eyebrow-ad-page: Adds a small pill label above a section heading on an ad landing page, naming the section in a word or two
ad-page/faqs: Answers common questions before a visitor books, as a short list of questions and answers near the bottom of an ad landing page
ad-page/features: Walks through the main features on an ad landing page as alternating rows of text beside an image
ad-page/footer-minimal: Closes an ad landing page with a single slim footer line, when no final call to action is needed
ad-page/footer-with-cta: Closes an ad landing page with a blue call-to-action panel followed by the legal line
ad-page/hero-alternate: Opens an ad landing page with a taller hero that also carries a client-logo strip and a testimonial quote under the fold
ad-page/hero-primary: Opens an ad landing page with the full-width headline, supporting text and main call to action
ad-page/timeline: Shows the steps from first call to going live on an ad landing page, four numbered steps in a row
ad-page/video: Presents a headline and short explanation beside a video on an ad landing page, to introduce the problem or product
dashboard/access-denied-screen: Fills the page when a signed-in person opens a page they are not allowed into, in place of a blank page or a redirect loop
dashboard/account-row: Shows who is signed in at the foot of the side rail, with their role and one sign out action
dashboard/action-button: Triggers any action a person takes on a screen, such as save, export, add or apply, with an optional icon beside the label
dashboard/activity-timeline: Lists the events on a record in time order, grouped by date, on a detail page or drawer
dashboard/analytics-overview-template: Starts an overview screen, campaign report or weekly readout showing how something performed over a period, against the previous one, broken down and listed
dashboard/app-shell: Provides the outer frame of every app screen, with the navigation rail on the left and the content panel on the right
dashboard/area-chart: Shows volume over time, or how a total is made up over time when stacked, inside a card on an overview screen
dashboard/avatar: Marks a person or account with a small generated square image, beside names in tables, lists, timelines and the account row
dashboard/avatar-group: Shows several people at once as overlapping avatars with a count for the rest, for owners or assignees on a record
dashboard/banner: Shows a dismissible message above a page or section about a lasting condition, such as connecting an integration or a read-only notice
dashboard/bar-chart: Compares values across a few categories or periods, with one to three series, inside a chart card
dashboard/board: Groups work items such as tasks, deals or reviews into stage columns, for screens where the stage matters most
dashboard/breadcrumbs: Shows where a nested or detail page sits in the hierarchy, above the page title, with a way back up
dashboard/breakdown-bar: Shows one split of a whole, such as a status mix, as a single bar of two to four parts inside a card
dashboard/build-notice: Tells a dashboard's owner that components it uses have changed, with Update now to open Claude Code with the fix ready, or Remind later
dashboard/bulk-action-bar: Appears over a table once rows are selected, showing how many are chosen with the actions to apply to them and a clear button
dashboard/card: Groups related content, such as a chart, a table or a form group, under one title on a screen
dashboard/chart-frame: Wraps a chart with its title, description, controls, legend and footnote, at a set height, inside a card
dashboard/chart-tooltip: Shows the values of each series, and an optional total, next to the cursor when hovering over any chart
dashboard/checkbox: Captures independent yes or no choices in a form, and selects rows in a table
dashboard/checklist: Lists getting-started steps with a progress count, for onboarding and setup on a home or empty screen
dashboard/coachmark: Walks a new user through a few real controls on a screen as a one-time guided tour
dashboard/column-menu: Lets people show or hide columns in a table that has more than about six columns
dashboard/combobox: Lets people pick one option from a long list, such as countries or owners, by typing to narrow it
dashboard/command-palette: Lets people jump to a page, record or action from the keyboard, opened with Cmd or Ctrl and K
dashboard/confirm-dialog: Asks for confirmation before a destructive or irreversible action, such as deleting a record, and sits over the page
dashboard/content-panel: Forms the white body of the app shell, holding a top bar with search and utilities above the single scrolling page area
dashboard/data-table: Lists five or more comparable records, such as leads, sessions or campaigns, in a sortable grid with several columns each
dashboard/date-range-picker: Lets people choose a start and end date with quick presets, as an inline panel or a popover from a compact trigger in a filter bar
dashboard/datetime-field: Captures an exact date, time and time zone in one field, for event filters and scheduled sends where a moment matters, not just a day
dashboard/delta-pill: Shows how a figure changed against a comparison period, as an arrow and value, on KPI cards and in table cells
dashboard/detail-view: Lays out the page for a single record: header with status and actions, tabs, an activity feed in the main column and properties beside it
dashboard/docked-panel: Holds settings or properties in a resizable side panel beside the page, for options used while looking at a chart or result
dashboard/donut-chart: Shows how a whole splits into up to three categories plus Other, with a centre total and a legend of values and shares
dashboard/drawer: Slides in from the right so someone can inspect or review one record, like a lead or log entry, while the list stays behind it
dashboard/empty-state: Fills a region that has nothing to show, saying what is missing and what to do, for first use, no results, no access or errors
dashboard/explorer-layout: Arranges an analytics tool page with a collapsible query panel on the left, chart above results table in the centre and optional details panel on the right
dashboard/filter-builder: Opens a popover where people combine several filter conditions, with field, operator and value per row, on tables and lists needing more than simple dropdowns
dashboard/filter-chip: Shows one applied filter as field, operator and value with a remove button, so the current narrowing stays visible above a table or list
dashboard/form-field: Wraps any input with a label, optional or required marker, help text and an error message, wherever a form asks for a value
dashboard/form-section: Groups related settings or fields under a title and description in a card on a settings page, with an optional footer for Save and Reset
dashboard/funnel: Shows step-to-step conversion with counts, percent of the first step and drop-off between steps, on analytics screens tracking a journey
dashboard/google-button: Starts Google sign-in on the login screen, using the unthemed white button with the four-colour G logo
dashboard/heatmap: Shows intensity across two dimensions, such as day by hour or a calendar of activity, as a grid of cells in five shades of one colour
dashboard/histogram: Shows event volume over time stacked by level above a log viewer, with a drag brush to pick the time range to inspect
dashboard/horizontal-bar-chart: Ranks items as rows of label, bar, value and share, for questions like top pages or top keywords where the biggest matters
dashboard/icon-button: Gives a compact glyph-only action such as more, copy, close or refresh in toolbars, rows and headers, with a tooltip and required label
dashboard/incident-row: Lists one entry in an incident history with its title, status, duration and time, on status or reliability pages
dashboard/info-hint: Adds a small info icon next to a metric or column name that opens a short definition on hover or focus
dashboard/issue-summary: Shows a compact strip of counters such as Critical, Warning and MTTR, above or beside incident and monitoring content
dashboard/key-value-list: Shows a record's properties as read-only label and value rows, in the side column of a detail page or inside a drawer
dashboard/legend: Names the series in a chart with swatch, label and value, and can click to hide or show a series
dashboard/legend-table: Sits under a chart with one row per series and values like total and average, where ticking a row shows or hides that series
dashboard/line-chart: Shows change over time for one to three series, with optional comparison, forecast, reference lines and event flags, on analytics and overview screens
dashboard/log-viewer: Shows dense monospace log lines with time, level, service and message, plus live tail, for reading service and job event streams top to bottom
dashboard/login-screen: Serves as the whole page a signed-out visitor lands on, including when sent back from a protected route, with the sign-in options in a centred card
dashboard/menu: Offers a list of actions or checkable options that opens from a button, such as Edit and Delete under an Actions trigger
dashboard/metric-strip: Shows a row of three to six key numbers above a chart, where selecting one switches the chart below to that metric
dashboard/modal: Holds one short task or decision that needs full attention, such as renaming, sharing or creating something, in a dialog over the page
dashboard/multi-select: Lets people pick several values, such as channels or countries, shown as removable chips with typing to filter the options
dashboard/nav-group: Groups related sidebar links under a label, or an expandable parent such as Reports with its own sub-pages
dashboard/nav-item: Links to one page or top-level section in the sidebar, with an icon, a label and an optional count
dashboard/page-header: Sets the title block at the top of a page, with title, description, action buttons and optional breadcrumbs or tab strip
dashboard/page-layout: Sets the grid, spacing and sticky strips of a page body, including the twelve-column grid and the settings split with a sub-nav
dashboard/pagination: Moves through a long table with a range count, items per page and previous and next buttons, placed below the table
dashboard/period-select: Lets people choose how far back a chart or table looks, such as 7 days, 30 days or all time
dashboard/popover: Shows small non-menu content hung off a trigger, such as a few column toggles, a short note or a small form
dashboard/progress-bar: Shows how far a value is toward a target, such as a budget, quota or completion, as a thin filled bar
dashboard/query-builder: Lets people compose an analysis by choosing what to chart, which metrics, filters, grouping and sorting, as rows of chips
dashboard/radio: Lets people choose exactly one option from a short set that is visible all at once
dashboard/ring: Shows one value such as completion or a score as a circle, where a bar would be too wide
dashboard/row-actions-menu: Gives each table row an overflow menu for three or more actions, with the destructive one last
dashboard/row-selection: Adds checkboxes to table rows, with a select-all in the header, so people can pick rows for bulk actions
dashboard/saved-views: Shows named, counted slices of one table such as All or Archived, and lets people save the current filters as a new one
dashboard/search-field: Filters the content in view as people type, with a magnifier icon and a clear button once there is text
dashboard/search-trigger: Shows a field-like button, with its shortcut, that opens the command palette, placed in the top bar or at the top of the sidebar
dashboard/segmented-control: Sets a view of the same data, such as table, board or list, or line, bar or table, from a short row of options
dashboard/select: Lets people pick one option from a known list of about three to fifteen, in a form or toolbar
dashboard/session-expired: Tells people their session has lapsed and brings them back to the same page after sign-in, as a banner or a modal
dashboard/setting-row: Shows one preference on a settings page, with label and description on the left and its control on the right
dashboard/shortcut-key: Shows a control's keyboard shortcut as a small key cap inside the button, after its label, so people can see the key without a separate hint line
dashboard/sidebar: Provides the main navigation rail down the left of the app, listing grouped top-level destinations with the brand and account at the edges
dashboard/sidebar-collapsed: Shrinks the sidebar to an icon-only rail when the content is wide, such as tables or the explorer layout
dashboard/sign-in-modal: Asks people to sign in inside a dialog, for example after clicking a locked row or when a session needs a full re-login
dashboard/skeleton: Fills a region with grey placeholders drawn at the real layout while data loads, so nothing jumps when it arrives
dashboard/sparkline: Shows a small trend line inside a table cell, stat card or list row, so people see direction at a glance without axes or exact values
dashboard/split-button: Offers one default action with a few related actions behind a caret, such as Copy page with Open in options, in a page or toolbar
dashboard/stat-card: Shows one headline number with its label, change and optional sparkline or progress, used three to six at a time at the top of a screen
dashboard/status-banner: Shows the overall state of a system, such as all systems operational, with an icon and period selector at the top of a status page
dashboard/status-dot: Marks which series or state a label belongs to with a small coloured dot, used inside a badge, a chart legend or a stat card label
dashboard/status-list: Lists services or components with a status each, and lets people expand a row to see detail like uptime or the last incident
dashboard/sub-nav: Gives a settings-style area a secondary menu down the left side, listing sibling pages like Profile, Security and API keys beside the content
dashboard/table-cell-types: Provides the standard cell shapes a data table uses, such as text, so every table prints its rows and columns the same way
dashboard/table-states: Shows what a table displays when it has no rows: loading, empty, error, or no results for the current filter, inside the same table frame
dashboard/table-toolbar: Sits in one row above a table with search, filter, columns, view switch and export, so people can narrow or reshape the data
dashboard/tabs-pill: Switches between views inside a page, such as Insights, Usage and Visits, using rounded pill tabs with optional counts
dashboard/tabs-underline: Switches between page-level sections such as Overview, Members and Billing, with an underlined tab bar that sits under the page header
dashboard/tag: Shows a user-facing category or filter chip, optionally removable, in lists, tables and filter rows; it is not for status
dashboard/text-input: Collects one line of free text, such as a work email or name, in a form or settings screen
dashboard/textarea: Collects longer free text such as notes and descriptions in a form, with a box that people can resize vertically
dashboard/theme-and-density: Sets the light and dark colours and the comfortable or compact sizing that every dashboard component follows once a page uses the base class
dashboard/theme-menu: Lets people choose System, Light or Dark appearance from a small menu in the panel bar or the phone top bar
dashboard/time-range-bar: Gives an analytics screen its single time control, with presets, custom dates, granularity, comparison period and a live switch above the charts
dashboard/timezone-select: Lets people pick a time zone from a long list by typing a city or offset, in a settings or scheduling form
dashboard/toast: Confirms the result of an action the user just took, such as an export ready or a save that failed, in a short message that does not block
dashboard/toggle: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect, such as a weekly summary, in settings screens, section headers, table rows and toolbars
dashboard/tooltip: Gives a short label or definition for an icon-only button or a metric on hover or focus, with a richer form for metric definitions
dashboard/topbar: Gives the phone layout its top bar with the brand, search and theme actions, and the menu button that opens the side rail
dashboard/unavailable-state: Marks a single card or section whose data could not be read, replacing its numbers with an Unavailable message while the rest of the page stays normal
dashboard/unsaved-changes-bar: Appears at the bottom of a settings form that saves explicitly, offering Reset and Save while any field differs from its saved value
dashboard/uptime-bar: Shows status over a run of days or hours as a strip of coloured segments with the uptime percentage, on a status or monitoring screen
dashboard/widget-grid: Lays out a home or overview dashboard people can arrange, with widgets in four sizes, an edit mode and a panel to add widgets
dashboard/workspace-switcher: Lets people who belong to two or more workspaces switch between them from the top of the side rail
lead-magnet/closer: Ends a lead-magnet PDF with the single ask: a headline, short body copy and one button on a black page
lead-magnet/cover: Opens a lead-magnet PDF with the logo, label chips, headline, intro text and a hero image on a black page
lead-magnet/document: Sets the page size, margins and print rules that every page of a downloadable lead-magnet PDF shares
lead-magnet/interior: Lays out the inside pages of a lead-magnet PDF, with a running head and white content rows on a light page
shared/badge: Labels a status or category as a small pill on cards, tables and dashboard tiles, in neutral, red, green, yellow, blue or black
shared/gushwork-logo: Places the Gushwork logo on pages and documents, in a chosen size, colour treatment and with or without the wordmark
shared/icons: Supplies the Phosphor icon set for buttons, labels, badges and navigation, in six weights and sizes from 12 to 40
slides/annotation: Adds one handwritten note with a hand-drawn arrow that points at a specific diagram, number or row on a slide, one per slide at most
slides/content-card: Holds all the content of a slide as a white rounded card sitting on the blue ground, below the title
slides/cover: Opens a deck as slide one, with an eyebrow chip, large title and image on its own textured background
slides/eyebrow: Labels a card or group with a short uppercase blue tag, such as MONTHLY or QUARTERLY, above its heading
slides/feature-row: Lists a feature on a slide as an icon tile with a heading and one line of body text, stacked with other rows in a column
slides/ground: Sets the blue gridded background behind every content slide, with the grid fading in from the corners
slides/icon-tile: Frames a small outline icon in a square next to a feature heading, so each point in a list has a visual marker
slides/layout-big-number: Puts one large statistic on the blue background with a single line of context beneath, and nothing else
slides/layout-closer: Ends a deck with one centred line, such as a thank you, on the plain blue background
slides/layout-divider: Breaks a long deck into sections with a centred eyebrow and heading on the plain blue background
slides/layout-feature-list: Presents four or five features as icon rows on the right, beside an image on the left of the card
slides/layout-full-bleed: Fills the whole card with one image, for when a screenshot, dashboard, chart or ranked search result is the point
slides/layout-pricing: Shows plans on a pricing slide with a heading, subhead, wide comparison table and a centred proof line at the bottom
slides/layout-split-card: Puts a lead paragraph on the left and an image on the right, as the default slide for explaining one idea
slides/layout-step-row: Lays out three or four equal cards across a slide to explain a process, cadence or phases in order
slides/layout-testimonial: Shows a customer quote beside their portrait with a name, company and result beneath, for a social proof slide
slides/layout-two-up: Places two large cards side by side to compare before and after, or Gushwork against the alternative
slides/lead-paragraph: Sets the main paragraph on the left of a split slide, with one outcome phrase picked out in blue
slides/media-well: Frames a cutout image, such as a phone or screenshot, on a textured panel beside the slide text
slides/rule-label: Names a group of cards with a small centred label and a thin line running out to each side, under a step row
slides/step-card: Shows one step or phase as a pale blue card with an eyebrow, heading and small footnote, repeated across a row
slides/title-bar: Gives each content slide its white title on the blue ground, above the card and always left aligned
tools/tool-action-pill: Holds a tool's main actions, such as switching view, downloading and copying, in one floating pill at the bottom of the canvas
tools/tool-chrome: Gives a hub tool its appearance and help menus, placed at the top right of the tool screen
tools/tool-panel: Holds a tool's controls in a floating, collapsible panel fixed to the left side of the screen
tools/tool-progress: Shows the state of a slow job, such as removing a photo background, beside the switch that started it
web/ai-agents: Shows a moving grid of agent cards in a full-width section, used to present the range of Gushwork AI agents on a marketing page
web/button: Gives marketing pages their clickable actions, such as the main call to action in a hero, fold or navbar, in blue, black, outlined or text styles
web/card-case-study: Presents a case study or blog post as a card with an image, category and headline that links through to the full story
web/card-information: Holds generic content as a title and body with an optional icon and image, the default card for any content in a grid
web/card-review: Shows a third-party review pulled from Trustpilot or G2, with the author header and a short quote, as social proof
web/card-testimonial: Shows a client proof captured by Gushwork, either a video or a quote with the client's photo and signature, inside testimonial rows
web/cards-grid: Lays out up to six feature or benefit cards in a full-width section, in grid, single or stacked layouts
web/cards-grid-small: Shows a single row of three to five cards in a full-width section, for compact lists of points or features
web/case-study-page: Tells one customer story as a full page, with outcome numbers in the hero, a prose column with a sticky call to action, and a closing section
web/client-avatar: Shows a real client or author photo in a grey rounded square, used in testimonials, bylines and case-study credits
web/client-logos: Shows a strip of client logos as social proof, in light versions on dark backgrounds and dark versions on light ones
web/comparison-table: Compares Gushwork against three competitors across a list of features in a four-column table, turned into stacked cards on phones
web/cta: Closes a page with a call-to-action section that reuses the footer's call-to-action banner, placed near the bottom before the footer
web/eyebrow: Adds a small pill label above a heading, such as a short topic line or a Trustpilot rating callout
web/faqs: Lists common questions as an expandable accordion in a full-width section, five by default and up to ten
web/fold-other: Provides a blank full-width section for custom content when none of the standard page sections fits
web/footer: Closes every marketing page with the call-to-action banner and link columns, or a plain copyright line on ad landing pages
web/form: Captures a lead inside a page section, either the short lead-potential check or the full lead form with a demo booking call to action
web/hero: Opens a page with the headline, description, buttons and an image, in home, centered, split or form layouts
web/image: Supplies product screenshots and before and after illustrations for page sections, cards and heroes, picked by the topic of the section
web/inline-input: Captures one piece of input, such as a work email, next to its button in a single row when one step moves the user forward
web/input-fields: Provides the form controls for marketing forms, including text, phone, dropdown, option card and checkbox fields with their states and warnings
web/navbar: Sits at the top of every marketing page, with the full navigation links on brand pages or a single button on ad pages
web/page-build: Assembles a complete page in the fixed order of navbar, hero, remaining sections and footer, in brand or ad versions
web/testimonial: Shows client proof in a full-width section, as a video testimonial or a single quote with the client's photo and signature
web/timeline: Walks through week-based steps of a process in a dark section, laid out horizontally on desktop and stacked on phones
web/video: Shows a video with a play control in a full-width section of a marketing page
web/with-image: Splits a section into text on one side and an image or media on the other, with an optional call to action
